_metadata.description: Design system preferences for the BuildRight construction project. Claude reads this file automatically when creating or modifying UI components.

usage_rules.backgrounds: Alternate dark (#1a1a1a, #2a2a2a) sections with light (#ffffff, #f5f5f5) sections
usage_rules.accent: Yellow (#FFC000) for CTAs, icons, section labels, decorative borders, and emphasis
usage_rules.text_on_dark: White for headings, #cccccc for body, #999999 for muted
usage_rules.hover_shadows: rgba(255, 192, 0, 0.35) for yellow elements, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) for dark elements

patterns.section_label: 13px, uppercase, 3px letter-spacing, yellow color, with 30px yellow line ::before

layout.approach: CSS Grid for main layouts, Flexbox for inline/nav elements

responsive_behavior.768px: Section padding reduces to 60px, grids become 1-2 col, mobile nav activates
responsive_behavior.480px: Single column layouts, reduced font sizes, simplified spacing

buttons.base: padding: 14px 32px, font-size: 15px, font-weight: 600, uppercase, 0.5px letter-spacing, border-radius: 8px

variants.btn-yellow: bg: #FFC000, color: #1a1a1a, hover: translateY(-2px) + shadow rgba(255,192,0,0.35)
variants.btn-outline: bg: transparent, border: 2px solid white, hover: bg white + color dark
variants.btn-dark: bg: #2a2a2a, color: white, hover: bg #1a1a1a + translateY(-2px)

cards.dark_card: bg: #2f2f2f, border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05), padding: 32px 24px, border-radius: 12px, hover: border-color yellow rgba
cards.light_card: bg: white, padding: 32px 24px, border-radius: 12px, box-shadow on hover

section_label.decoration: 30px x 2px yellow line before text via ::before pseudo-element

corner_brackets.description: Yellow corner brackets on featured images using ::before and ::after pseudo-elements

css.before: top: -12px, left: -12px, width: 100px, height: 100px, border-top: 4px solid var(--yellow), border-left: 4px solid var(--yellow)
css.after: bottom: -12px, right: -12px, width: 100px, height: 100px, border-bottom: 4px solid var(--yellow), border-right: 4px solid var(--yellow)

experience_badge.description: Absolute-positioned badge with yellow background showing years of experience
experience_badge.style: position: absolute, bg: yellow, padding, bold text, z-index above image

hero_badge.description: Inline-flex badge with rgba yellow background and yellow border
hero_badge.style: display: inline-flex, bg: rgba yellow, border: 1px solid yellow, border-radius

hover_effects.scale: transform: scale(1.08) on project card images
hover_effects.border_glow: border-color transitions to yellow rgba on card hover

section_patterns.rule: Never stack more than 2 same-tone sections. Accent (yellow) sections break up the rhythm.

design_philosophy.tone: Strength, reliability, and precision through strong contrasts and clean lines
principles: Dark-dominant aesthetic with yellow as power accent
Generous spacing and breathing room between elements
Corner bracket decorations on key images for industrial feel
Uppercase CTAs with letter-spacing for authority
Subtle hover animations (lift + shadow) for interactivity
Accessibility: ARIA labels, reduced-motion support, semantic HTML
avoid: Overly complex animations or parallax effects
More than 3 font weights on a single page
Decorative elements that don't serve a structural purpose
